tolerance_classes.EXACT_VALUE: integers, strings, enums, booleans, statuses, reasons, ids, error classes, None / null, list lengths and orders, dict key SETS (Python dict insertion order carries no meaning in these records and is not compared), and floats that are copied (not computed): equal (floats by value, -0.0 == 0.0; non-finite floats are transported as the strings 'NaN', '+inf', '-inf' and compared as strings)
tolerance_classes.ULP_BOUNDED: |rust - py| <= k_ulp * ulp(py) OR |rust - py| <= r_rel * |py| OR |rust - py| <= a_abs, k_ulp / r_rel / a_abs fixed per observable group below (an absent clause is not applied); relative clause scaled by |py| (not max(1, |py|)): the observables span 1e-30 .. 1e9. ulp(py) = math.ulp(py)
tolerance_classes.SOLVER_TOLERANCE: convergence / solver status EXACT_VALUE; solution |rust - py| <= abs_tol + rel_tol * |py| with abs_tol / rel_tol fixed per entry below and tied to the solver's own tolerance; iteration and function-evaluation counts reported, not scored
tolerance_classes.EXACT_STREAM: not used (no RNG in either implementation)

tolerance_basis.registered: the filter arithmetic is a fixed sequence of IEEE products / sums / divisions that the Rust port repeats in the reference order (bit-identical expected); the only library calls are sqrt (correctly rounded) and log / exp in the Cole interpolation (glibc libm in both). k_ulp 4 / r_rel 1e-12 bounds a few-ulp libm difference through at most three log / one exp evaluation. Difference-type outputs can cancel to a small value whose ulp is meaningless; their floor 1e-12 x the vector's incident flow is far below any physical resolution

exact_invariants.statement: determinism: the Rust CLI run twice on the full vector set gives byte-identical stdout; the Python reference evaluated twice gives equal records

It is NOT physics validation.
